lib.format.pdf: Opens on any phone or computer
lib.format.md: For notes apps and AI chats
lib.shareStenny.title: Copy the link to stenny.eu
lib.shareStenny.aria: Share Stenny: copy the link to stenny.eu
lib.summaryOnTop: Put the summary at the top of shared copies
lib.nothingYet.live: While the Mac is plugged in, the text appears here as the recording goes on.
lib.nothingYet.later: The text appears here once the transcript is being made.
lib.emptyCourse.hint: Start a recording from Stenny in the menu bar; its transcript appears here.
lib.emptyCourse.hint.windows: Start a recording from Stenny's icon in the notification area; its transcript appears here.
lib.menu.stillRecording: Still recording. To throw it away, use Cancel Recording… in Stenny's menu bar.
lib.menu.stillRecording.windows: Still recording. To throw it away, use Cancel Recording… in Stenny's menu in the notification area.
lib.menu.beingMade: Its transcript is being made. Rename or delete it when that's done.
add.title: Add a course
add.text: Mixed is for lecturers who switch languages within a lecture. Auto is for one language per lecture, but not always the same one.
add.name: Name
renameGroup.text.event: Its folder and files are renamed too.
renameGroup.text.course: Its folder, files and Obsidian links are renamed too. The old name still finds it in your calendar.
remove.title: Remove {course}?
remove.text.none: It leaves this list and calendar matching. Nothing was recorded for it yet; its glossary, if it has one, stays. You'll find it under Past courses in Settings ▸ Courses, where you can bring it back or delete it.
remove.text.one: It leaves this list and calendar matching. Its transcript and glossary stay. You'll find it under Past courses in Settings ▸ Courses, where you can bring it back or delete it.
remove.text.other: It leaves this list and calendar matching. Its {n} transcripts and glossary stay. You'll find it under Past courses in Settings ▸ Courses, where you can bring it back or delete it.
deleteGroup.title: Delete {name}?
deleteGroup.text.course.none: This deletes the course and also everything Stenny saved for it: transcripts, summaries, audio and everything else in Stenny's folders, its glossary included. It also leaves the menu. Everything goes to the {trash}; once it's emptied, it's gone for good.
deleteGroup.text.course.one: This deletes the course and also its recording: transcripts, summaries, audio and everything else in Stenny's folders, its glossary included. It also leaves the menu. Everything goes to the {trash}; once it's emptied, it's gone for good.
deleteGroup.text.course.other: This deletes the course and also all {n} of its lectures: transcripts, summaries, audio and everything else in Stenny's folders, its glossary included. It also leaves the menu. Everything goes to the {trash}; once it's emptied, it's gone for good.
deleteGroup.text.event.none: This deletes the talk and also everything Stenny saved for it: transcripts, summaries, audio and everything else in Stenny's folders. Everything goes to the {trash}; once it's emptied, it's gone for good.
deleteGroup.text.event.one: This deletes the talk and also its recording: transcripts, summaries, audio and everything else in Stenny's folders. Everything goes to the {trash}; once it's emptied, it's gone for good.
deleteGroup.text.event.other: This deletes the talk and also all {n} of its recordings: transcripts, summaries, audio and everything else in Stenny's folders. Everything goes to the {trash}; once it's emptied, it's gone for good.
renameLecture.text.number: The title shows instead of “Lecture {n}”. Leave it empty to go back to the number.
renameLecture.text.other: The title shows instead of the date. Leave it empty to show the date again.
deleteLecture.title: Move {name} to the {trash}?
deleteLecture.text.lecture: Its transcript, summary and audio go to the {trash}, where you can put them back. Later lectures of the course move up a number.
deleteLecture.text.event: Its transcript, summary and audio go to the {trash}, where you can put them back.
settings.title: Settings
settings.uiLanguage.hint: For Stenny's windows, menus and notifications. Transcripts keep the language of their course.
settings.login.approval: Allow it in System Settings ▸ General ▸ Login Items.
settings.login.hint: So the calendar's lecture reminders work without thinking of it.
settings.shortcut.hint: Pauses and resumes the recording from any app.
settings.shortcut.needsModifier: Hold ⌘, ⌃ or ⌥ too, so the shortcut doesn't get in the way of typing.
settings.shortcut.notYet: Saved, but it doesn't work yet: {problem}
settings.places.transcripts.hint: Lectures, summaries and glossaries, one folder per course.
settings.places.talks.hint: Recordings that aren't part of a course.
settings.places.data.hint: Audio, the raw transcripts and logs. They never leave this Mac.
settings.mic.hint: The one the next recording uses; the menu bar can switch it during a lecture.
settings.backup.hint: Recorded alongside, and used only where the main one sent nothing.
settings.draft.hint: A live draft to read along when the Mac is plugged in. Off: record only, transcribe afterwards.
settings.keepAudio.hint: Archived in Stenny's own files, to listen again or transcribe anew.
settings.ai.lead: After each lecture, AI adds section headings linked to your slides, fixes misheard terms from your glossary and slides, and can write a summary. It never rewrites what was said. Only the text leaves this Mac, never the audio.
settings.ai.lead.windows: After each lecture, AI adds section headings linked to your slides, fixes misheard terms from your glossary and slides, and can write a summary. It never rewrites what was said. Only the text leaves this computer, never the audio.
settings.ai.claudeCode.line: Uses your Claude subscription. No extra cost.
settings.ai.api.line: Pay as you go with your own API key, about $0.01 per lecture.
settings.ai.off.line: Transcripts only: no headings, no fixed terms, no summaries.
settings.ai.cc.missing: Claude Code isn't installed on this Mac. It's separate from the Claude desktop app, and free with your subscription.
settings.ai.cc.missing.windows: Claude Code isn't installed on this computer. It's separate from the Claude desktop app, and free with your subscription.
settings.ai.cc.missing.after: Once it's installed, come back here to sign in.
settings.ai.cc.signedOut: Claude Code is installed but not signed in to your Claude account.
settings.ai.cc.signingIn: Finish signing in in the terminal window and your browser. Stenny checks again when you come back.
settings.ai.api.noKey: Paste your API key. Stenny checks it with Anthropic and keeps it in the Keychain, not in its settings.
settings.ai.api.noKey.windows: Paste your API key. Stenny checks it with Anthropic and keeps it in Windows Credential Manager, not in its settings.
settings.ai.api.badKey: Anthropic doesn't accept the saved key ({hint}). Paste a new one.
settings.ai.api.badEnv: Anthropic doesn't accept the key in ANTHROPIC_API_KEY ({hint}).
settings.ai.api.create: Get a key in the Claude Console
settings.ai.off.note: Your transcripts stay complete, word for word. They just won't have section headings, slide links, fixed terms, topic notes or summaries.
settings.claude.lead: With the Stenny connector, any chat in the Claude desktop app can search your lectures, read them and cite them, like “Lecture 3 [0:12:30]”.
settings.claude.example: Try asking: “Go through last Tuesday's lecture with me and quiz me on it.”
settings.claude.installed: Installed. You'll find it in Claude under Settings ▸ Customize ▸ Connectors.
settings.claude.disabled: Installed but switched off. Switch it on in Claude under Settings ▸ Customize ▸ Connectors.
settings.claude.notInstalled: Not installed yet. Claude shows its own Install window: click Install there.
settings.claude.opened: Claude has opened its Install window. Click Install there; Stenny checks again when you come back.
settings.claude.noDesktop: The Claude desktop app isn't on this Mac yet. Get it first, then install the connector here.
settings.claude.noDesktop.windows: The Claude desktop app isn't on this computer yet. Get it first, then install the connector here.
settings.claude.noFile: Stenny.mcpb is missing from Stenny's folder, so the connector can't be installed from here.
settings.claude.where: Works in the Claude desktop app on this Mac. Claude on the web and on your phone can't reach your lectures: they never leave this Mac.
settings.claude.where.windows: Works in the Claude desktop app on this computer. Claude on the web and on your phone can't reach your lectures: they never leave this computer.
settings.claude.code.hint: Also use the connector in Claude Code, in every project.
settings.claude.remove.desktop.title: Remove Stenny from Claude
settings.claude.remove.desktop.text: Claude removes its connectors itself: in Claude, open Settings ▸ Customize ▸ Connectors, click Stenny and remove it there. Your chats stay, and you can install it again here anytime.
settings.claude.remove.code.title: Remove Stenny from Claude Code?
settings.claude.remove.code.text: Claude Code can't read your lectures any more, in any project. You can add it again here anytime.
settings.summary.hint: An AI summary next to each transcript, clearly labelled as one.
settings.model: Transcription runs on this Mac with {model}.
settings.background.lead: Transcribing a lecture takes a while. These keep the Mac usable meanwhile.
settings.priority.normal.hint: As fast as possible; the Mac may feel busy.
settings.priority.low.hint: Gives way to whatever you're doing.
settings.priority.background.hint: Heavily throttled: slow, but you won't notice it.
settings.power.hint: Queued transcripts wait until the Mac is plugged in.
settings.night.hint: Queued transcripts run only in these hours.
settings.courses.lead: Your courses and the language each one is taught in.
settings.removeCourse.text.none: It leaves your courses and calendar matching. Nothing was recorded for it yet; its glossary, if it has one, stays. It moves to Past courses below, where you can bring it back or delete it.
settings.removeCourse.text.one: It leaves your courses and calendar matching. Its transcript and glossary stay. It moves to Past courses below, where you can bring it back or delete it.
settings.removeCourse.text.other: It leaves your courses and calendar matching. Its {n} transcripts and glossary stay. It moves to Past courses below, where you can bring it back or delete it.
settings.courses.mixed: Can switch language mid-sentence; checked every few seconds among:
settings.courses.auto: One language per lecture, recognised among:
settings.past.lead: Courses you removed from the list. Their transcripts and glossaries are kept until you delete them.
settings.deleteCourse.text.none: Nothing was recorded for it. Its settings are removed, and its glossary, if it has one, goes to the {trash}.
settings.deleteCourse.text.one: This deletes the course and its lecture: transcripts, summaries, audio and its glossary. Everything goes to the {trash}; once it's emptied, it's gone for good.
settings.deleteCourse.text.other: This deletes the course and all {n} of its lectures: transcripts, summaries, audio and its glossary. Everything goes to the {trash}; once it's emptied, it's gone for good.
feedback.onClipboard: {error} Your message is on the clipboard, so it isn't lost.
feedback.title: Send feedback
feedback.lead: What works, what doesn't, what you'd want. It goes straight to the person who makes Stenny.
feedback.contact: Your email, if you'd like a reply (optional)
feedback.details: Include Stenny's version, this Mac's model and the last lines of Stenny's log
talk.needsTitle: Give the talk a title, like “Guest talk on climate models”.
talk.title: Record a talk or event
talk.lead: Not one of your courses: a guest talk, a meeting, a panel. Its transcript goes to Talks & events.
talk.placeholder: Title, e.g. Guest talk on climate models
talk.mixed: For speakers who switch: English, German and French are told apart as the talk goes.
menu.status.noAudio: No audio from the microphone · reconnecting …
menu.noCourses: No courses yet: add one in Stenny's window
note.restarted: Recording {course} again after a problem. Nothing recorded is lost; the transcript comes later.
note.stopped: The recording of {course} stopped. What was recorded is saved; its transcript comes later.
consent.record.course.question: Did the lecturer agree to being recorded?
consent.record.course.why: Recording a lecture usually needs the lecturer's OK.
consent.record.event.question: Did the speaker agree to being recorded?
consent.record.event.why: Recording a talk usually needs the speaker's OK.
consent.share.course.question: Did the lecturer agree to this?
consent.share.course.why: Transcripts of a lecture usually need the lecturer's OK before they're passed on.
consent.share.event.question: Did the speaker agree to this?
consent.share.event.why: Transcripts of a talk usually need the speaker's OK before they're passed on.
cancelRec.title: Delete this recording?
cancelRec.message: The recording of {course} stops without a transcript. Its audio and the text so far go to the {trash}.
quit.title: A lecture is being recorded
quit.message: Stop it now (the final transcript is made afterwards), or keep it recording in the background? You can control it again by reopening Stenny.
updates.upToDate.title: Stenny is up to date
updates.available.title: Stenny {version} is available
error.noAgentPdf: The PDF couldn't be made: stenny-agent is missing.
setup.title: Finish setting up Stenny
setup.allSet.text: Stenny is fully set up. Settings has everything if you want to change something.
setup.courses.name: Add your courses
setup.courses.why: Each recording is filed under its course, with the course's language and glossary.
setup.ai.name: Let Claude tidy up your transcripts
setup.ai.why: Section headings linked to your slides, fixed terms and a summary. What was said is never rewritten.
setup.ai.offChosen: Off, as you chose. You can turn it on in Settings anytime.
setup.ai.cc.missing: Claude Code isn't installed yet. It's free with your Claude subscription.
setup.ai.cc.signedOut: Sign in to Claude Code with your Claude account.
setup.ai.api.paste: Paste your Anthropic API key. Stenny checks it and keeps it in the Keychain.
setup.ai.api.paste.windows: Paste your Anthropic API key. Stenny checks it and keeps it in Credential Manager.
setup.claude.name: Add Stenny to Claude
setup.claude.why: Then any chat in the Claude desktop app can search, read and cite your lectures.
setup.claude.done.desktop: Installed in the Claude desktop app
setup.claude.noDesktop: Get the Claude desktop app first, then install Stenny into it from here.
